differences.a_observable: Strong shadows between the 3D tiles, creating high contrast and depth.
differences.b_observable: Very weak, flat shadows between the tiles, making the grid look flat.
differences.fix: Increase shadow intensity and depth of the 3D tiles.

differences.a_observable: The white background tiles have a distinct cool blue color cast.
differences.b_observable: The white background tiles are neutral grey/warm off-white.
differences.fix: Adjust color temperature to introduce a cool blue cast.

differences.a_observable: Background and foreground tiles are softly blurred due to shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: All tiles across the frame are uniformly sharp, lacking depth of field blur.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera to blur the foreground and background.

json.highest_impact_fix: Increase shadow intensity and depth of the 3D tiles to match the contrast and depth of the reference.
